title: Family reunification notice / card
description: Family reunification after an evacuation or lockdown at a school, campus, venue or workplace. Variant 'notice': the one-page notice to families (where to go, when it opens, what to bring, what to expect, do not come to the incident site, translated line). Variant 'card': the two-part reunification request / release card (parent or guardian fills the top half by hand, staff complete the release half below the tear line). Neutral layout, not any copyrighted card. The organization and places are simulated. One Letter page.

org.description: Issuing organization (school district, university, venue operator, employer)

site.description: The incident site families must not go to
examples: Riverbend High School, 2200 Mill River Rd

headline.description: Headline of the notice, or the card title for the card variant
examples: All students are safe and have been moved to a reunification site

situation.description: Short, factual statement of what happened (no speculation)
examples: At 10:15 a.m. Riverbend High School was evacuated after a reported threat. Police are at the school.

reunificationSite.description: Where families go to pick up

examples: 1200 Lake Ave, Riverbend (enter from the north lot on Elm St)

opensAt.description: When the reunification site opens to families

examples: Check in at the request tables and fill out one reunification card per student.
Wait in the family area while a runner brings your student to the release door.
Government-issued photo ID (driver's license, passport, state ID)
Do not go to Riverbend High School. Roads around the school are closed.
Park at the Lakeshore Plaza lot; a free shuttle runs every 10 minutes.

languageNote.description: Translated line for non-English-speaking families (defaults to a Spanish line)
examples: Todos los estudiantes están a salvo. Recoja a su estudiante en el centro de reunificación con una identificación con foto.

student.description: Student (or employee, attendee) to be released, written by the requester (card variant)

teacher.description: Teacher at the time of the incident

requester.description: Parent or guardian asking for release (card variant)

idChecked.description: Staff checked the photo ID against the requester

authorized.description: Requester is listed on the student's emergency card / release authorization

release.description: Release half completed by staff (card variant)

staffInitials.description: Initials of the releasing staff member

notes.description: Notes (custody flags, student not located, sent to counseling)
